limitations: Repository names are discovery leads, not product identities.
The census does not inspect every repository's manifest, release workflow, tags, package metadata, deployments, or UI surfaces.
Fork-named repositories are not automatically excluded from product status; they are merely not elevated by the non-fork review heuristic.
A repository may contain multiple applications, and one application may span multiple repositories.
No AppID, package ID, signing mode, release channel, or surface is invented.
